clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Addresses Potential Vice Presidential Candidacy
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad stated he respects the president's authority to propose a replacement for the vice presidential vacancy.
Several political and organizational figures have identified Gerindra members, including Dasco, as potential candidates.

clusters.headline: Proposed Relocation Of Javan Rhinos Faces Continued Public Scrutiny
aiSummaryBullets: Legislators and indigenous leaders have called for a rigorous scientific review regarding the potential relocation of Javan rhinos.
Experts emphasize that moving the species requires strict habitat suitability assessments to ensure their survival and well-being.

clusters.headline: Police Ethics Tribunal Begins Closed Session For Irjen Eko Hadi
aiSummaryBullets: The Police Ethics Commission began a closed-door hearing regarding allegations of illegal wiretapping against Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso.
The proceedings involve investigations by the Propam Division into alleged professional misconduct by the high-ranking officer.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Participates In Manila ASEAN Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto attended the 29th ASEAN-Japan Summit held in Manila, Philippines.
The Indonesian President urged member nations to transition into technology manufacturing hubs rather than remaining consumer markets.

clusters.headline: Raffi Ahmad Clarifies Government Projects And Denies Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Raffi Ahmad issued an apology regarding ICW findings and pledged to donate 15 billion rupiah for disaster relief efforts.
The Presidential Envoy stated he had previously consulted with the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) regarding his professional engagements.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Gains Broad Support As Potential Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Deputy House Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is being discussed as a potential candidate for Vice President to succeed Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Proponents cite his ability to maintain political stability and his track record of working with diverse groups including labor organizations.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Gold Prices Experience Decline In Mid-November Trading
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices decreased by Rp7,000 to reach Rp2,515,000 per gram as of November 17, 2026.
Pegadaian reported simultaneous price reductions across three major gold brands in its Tuesday morning update.

clusters.headline: Geological Agency Confirms No Tsunami Risk After Banda Sea Quake
aiSummaryBullets: A 7.1 magnitude tectonic earthquake occurred in the Banda Sea, affecting parts of Maluku and reaching as far as Papua.
Indonesian geological authorities stated the event poses no tsunami risk to the surrounding coastal areas.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Customs Officials Sentenced Following Import Bribery Case
aiSummaryBullets: Three former customs officials were recently sentenced to prison terms ranging from six to nine years for their involvement in bribery.
The Corruption Eradication Commission is actively pursuing new leads, including the questioning of additional suspects linked to customs corruption.

clusters.headline: Legislators And Government Discuss Proposed Population ID Reform
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian House of Representatives has initiated discussions on the Population Administration Draft Bill.
The proposed legislation aims to integrate identity services through a single identification number to streamline public services.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Expands International And Regional Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo proposed strategic collaborations with South Korea in the energy and semiconductor sectors.
ASEAN member states reached a consensus on utilizing space technology to support regional economic growth and disaster mitigation efforts.

clusters.headline: Police Advance Investigation Into Kupang Regent Rape Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Police in East Nusa Tenggara have seized clothing items as evidence following an inspection of the Kupang Regent's official residence.
Regional Police Chief Irjen Pol. Reza Arief Dewanto committed to conducting a transparent investigation without external interference.

clusters.headline: Government Announces New Formula For 2027 Minimum Wage Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The 2027 provincial minimum wage is scheduled for official announcement on November 21.
The new calculation mechanism is based on the Law on Worker Protection and incorporates standard living requirements as key variables.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U17 National Team Faces Afghanistan In Qualifier Match
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesia U17 squad is scheduled to compete against Afghanistan in the 2027 AFC U17 Asian Cup qualifiers.
The national team recently secured a 2-0 victory against Cambodia in the ongoing qualifying tournament.

clusters.headline: KPK Detains Former Staff Of Anwar Sadad In East Java Grant Case
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK has detained Bagus Wahyudiono, a former staff member of Anwar Sadad, regarding an ongoing corruption case involving provincial grants.
Investigators have seized two properties belonging to the suspect as part of the probe into grant misuse in East Java between 2019 and 2022.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General To Question Bekasi Mayor In KSO Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office summoned the Mayor of Bekasi, Tri Adhianto, for questioning regarding a joint operation case.
The inquiry is part of an ongoing investigation into alleged corruption involving the management of city-owned energy enterprises.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Launch Nationwide Zebra Traffic Enforcement Drive
aiSummaryBullets: Regional police units across Indonesia have initiated the two-week Zebra 2026 traffic enforcement campaign.
Authorities are utilizing electronic traffic law enforcement systems alongside manual officer patrols to target specific violations.

clusters.headline: University Of Indonesia Clarifies Sekolah Rakyat Location Plans
aiSummaryBullets: The University of Indonesia stated that the proposed eight-hectare site for the Sekolah Rakyat project is within campus boundaries.
University officials clarified that the designated land does not overlap with the existing city forest zone.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Address Fuel Subsidy Costs And Market Prices
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials confirm that fuel subsidy allocations remain secure for the remainder of 2026 despite rising global oil prices.
Finance Ministry representatives stated that market prices for Pertalite and Solar fuels significantly exceed the current subsidized consumer rates.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets December 9 For Vice Presidential Election Selection Session
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has officially scheduled the vice presidential selection and inauguration session for December 9, 2026.
President Prabowo is required to submit two candidates for the position no later than November 25, 2026.
